set.body:
Build the executable comparison boundary without contaminating foundation dependencies.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-432-01: The unpublished runner reads and writes fixtures through image4s-nifti and invokes the canonical reframe4s-motion public pipeline.
AC-432-02: Pinned AFNI 3dvolreg, nifreeze, and FSL MCFLIRT adapters capture corrected images, transforms, stage times, stdout, stderr, tool metadata, resource measurements, and failures in one versioned result schema. Optional FLIRT and RNiftyReg adapters use the same schema.
AC-432-03: Independent convention fixtures prove every adapter input-to-reference or reference-to-input conversion against physical landmark mappings on nontrivial complete affines.
AC-432-04: The estimation court applies all recovered transforms through the same canonical resampler. The native court separately evaluates each declared production pipeline and records every interpolation or resampling opportunity.
AC-432-05: All methods receive equivalent frames, masks, reference selection, thread limits, and declared inputs; unavoidable differences are recorded rather than normalized away after results are known.
AC-432-06: The runner supports paired randomized repeated execution, single-thread and one declared practical parallel policy, isolated outputs, and separate I/O, startup, estimation, application, and reporting measurements.
AC-432-07: It emits deterministic raw per-frame and per-run results plus schema-validated aggregates, checksums, complete failure rows, and no silent skips.
AC-432-08: A small hermetic smoke fixture runs in ordinary CI; the full pinned courts are separately scheduled or manually dispatched.
